heroSummary: Most TPS students start Wednesday, August 19, 2026. Pre-K students attend a short assessment with a parent or guardian on August 19 or 20, and their first full day is Friday, August 21. Thanksgiving Break runs November 23–27, Winter Break runs December 21–January 1, and Spring Break runs March 15–19. calendarNotes: Most TPS students start August 19. Pre-K students attend a short assessment with a parent or guardian on August 19 or 20, and their first full day is August 21. The family calendar publishes May 28 as the last day and notes that it includes three weather days; the teacher calendar supplies the exact sliding rule from May 25 through May 28. October 13 and January 19 are no-class parent-teacher conference days, with schools responsible for exact conference dates and times. The Spanish PDF's event list says March 19 for spring conferences, but its legend and highlighted date, the English family calendar and the teacher calendar all show January 19. Quarter dates mark grading periods and do not always fall on student attendance days; Quarter 2 begins October 13 even though classes are not held that day.

customSections.label: How Weather Days Can Move the TPS Last Day
customSections.content: The family calendar publishes May 28 as the last day because it includes three weather days. The teacher calendar shows the last student day when zero, one, two, or three weather days are used. If more than three inclement-weather days are needed, TPS says the calendar will be extended or the missed time will be made up another way. Check the live TPS calendar for any resulting change.

table.caption: TPS 2026–27 last student day by weather days used
table.footnote: Do not treat May 28 as fixed until TPS confirms weather-day use.

customSections.label: Why the Spanish TPS Calendar Shows a Different Conference Date
customSections.content: TPS marks October 13 and January 19 as no-class conference days and tells families to check their school for exact dates and times. March 19 appears only in the Spanish calendar's event list. The same PDF's legend and highlighted date show January 19, which also matches the English family calendar and teacher calendar.

table.footnote: We use January 19 here and in the downloadable calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are on the TPS 2026–27 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The four official quarter counts total 168 student days: 37 in Quarter 1, 39 in Quarter 2, and 46 in each of Quarters 3 and 4.

calendarFaqs.q: Will the downloaded TPS calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The ICS file is a one-time copy. Use the official live calendar and school messages for revisions and confirmation of the final day of classes.
